title: ListIdentity discovery request with framed response
purpose: Exercise discovery dispatch and response-data handling using a complete request header followed by a distinct, length-consistent response frame.

messages.label: ListIdentity response with one compact payload item

expected_behavior: The server should dispatch ListIdentity and emit a properly framed discovery response, or reject the request cleanly if discovery is unavailable.
constraints_preserved: Both messages contain complete 24-byte EtherNet/IP encapsulation headers.
The request declares a zero-byte payload.
The response declares and carries exactly four payload bytes.
Request and response directions are explicit and indices are ordered.
The discovery path is distinct from session and explicit-message paths.
issue_safety_notes: This is a conservative response-handling analogue informed by the supplied issue reports. The compact response payload is a mutation seed, not a claim of a fully populated device identity, and no historical crash stream is copied.
